title: termal_list_sessions occasionally returns a plain "TermAl del…" error text instead of the JSON session list
outcome: termal_list_sessions either returns the JSON session list or a structured error, and a transient failure carries a stable error code and the HTTP status, so callers can tell a transient host error from a malformed reply.
acceptance: The plain-text 'TermAl delegation API returned …' path of termal_list_sessions is identified, with the HTTP status or condition that produced it.
The tool returns a structured error object (code, status, message) for that path, and a test covers it; the review pair is clean.
